title: Integrators
note: Public snapshot of the Integrators tab of the Why Humanoid? master workbook: every provider with all 26 fields, as the sheet states them, plus tags read from the cells with fixed vocabularies and a reviewed evidence grouping. Records are provider and partner claims as recorded, not independently verified results. Free.

statuses.label: Humanoid-specific provider
statuses.note: Explicit humanoid work or offering in reviewed sources. Not a validation of production results.

statuses.label: Requested specialist exception
statuses.note: Included at the editor’s request as a specialist exception. Not counted as a humanoid provider.

statuses.label: Humanoid scope unconfirmed
statuses.note: Not counted as a humanoid provider.

groups.label: Named project, corroborated
groups.explanation: A named customer or partner project confirmed by the customer, a partner or a joint announcement. Pilot or proof-of-concept scale unless the sources say more.

groups.label: Named project, provider-reported
groups.explanation: A named project or operated robot described by the provider itself, without customer or partner corroboration in the reviewed sources.

groups.label: Partnership announced
groups.explanation: An integration or service partnership or agreement announced by the provider, the manufacturer or both. No named end-customer completion.

groups.label: Published technical or research work
groups.explanation: Published documentation, code, lab engineering or a university-confirmed collaboration. Not a customer deployment.

groups.label: Commercial offering
groups.explanation: A described humanoid product or service offering, sometimes with a demonstrator or a proposed protocol. No named completed humanoid project.

groups.label: Simulated tests only
groups.explanation: Requested specialist exception: provider-reported simulated tests. No humanoid validation, no completed humanoid integration and no safety or unlearning guarantee.

groups.label: Humanoid scope unconfirmed
groups.explanation: Historical record kept for continuity. Reviewed sources show service-robot work but do not establish humanoid work.
